valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.peRouteNote: the two P/E routes differ (market cap over net profit 2.78, price over EPS 3.42); the net-profit row reconciles with the filing's own profit before tax less tax, so the EPS row is the one filed in a different unit
valuation.ps_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (socitarabeinternationaledebanquesae) is served under two keys, SAIB P/E 2.78 and SAIB.CA P/E 3.25, and they disagree; one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
